**BLUF:** Ukrainian naval drones from a mothership sank the Russian corvette *Merkury* at its berth in Benghazi, Libya, with satellite imagery confirming the vessel capsized; Libya’s eastern government condemned the strike as a “declaration of war” and announced plans for UN and ICJ action.[[1]](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/ukraine-naval-drones-strike-russian-warship-libya)[[2]](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/22/blast-russian-ship-suspected-drone-attack-benghazi-libya) Iran claimed a missile/drone strike on US Patriot radars in Bahrain while Bahrain reported only a civilian industrial fire in Sitra with two injuries.[[3]](https://houseofsaud.com/iran-bahrain-sitra-nov22/) Multiple tanker incidents continued in/near the Strait of Hormuz with IRGC claims of responsibility.[[4]](https://x.com/osinthexagone/status/2124993597665624177) Russian strikes hit Ukrainian energy infrastructure and a residential building near Kyiv; Ukrainian deep strikes damaged the Kerch Bridge rail/road spans. China issued fresh MSA navigational warnings for live-fire and military exercises in the East China Sea, Bohai, and South China Sea through late November.[[5]](https://www.csis.org/analysis/what-chinas-recent-military-surge-was-and-wasnt)

## 1. CHATTER AND THE INFORMATION ENVIRONMENT

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Pro-Ukrainian and monitoring accounts, including @FAB87F and @Realxvox, circulated satellite imagery and analysis showing the Russian corvette *Merkury* capsized in Benghazi port after the Ukrainian drone strike, with only the bow visible; posts noted Libya’s Presidential Council condemning the operation as a declaration of war and planning UNSC and ICJ referrals. Reach was widespread among OSINT and Ukraine-focused accounts within hours of Zelenskyy’s confirmation; no independent geolocation disputes emerged in sampled posts.[[6]](https://x.com/Realxvox/status/2124995229816344598)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Accounts including @FAB87F and @Zebra_Fella highlighted ongoing Ukrainian strikes on the Kerch Bridge (road and rail spans damaged) alongside the Benghazi operation and Baltic Sea incidents, framing them as expansion of pressure on Russian logistics; posts referenced satellite confirmation and pro-Russian Telegram “heroic last stand” narratives. Organic spread among Ukraine-support accounts; Russian milblogger channels pushed counter-narratives of intercepted drones.[[7]](https://x.com/FAB87F/status/2124993330283217223)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Accounts and @denise_gradin discussed Iranian claims of destroying two US Patriot radars at Al-Riffa/Awali bases in Bahrain versus Bahraini reports of a civilian Sitra industrial site fire injuring two; IRGC-linked posts tied the strike to US Hormuz escorts. Mixed reach; Iranian state media amplified claims while Bahraini sources emphasized intercepts and civilian impact.[[8]](https://x.com/JohnTheMainGuy1/status/2124994894548648363)

[HUMINT - CHATTER] Maritime OSINT accounts (@osinthexagone, @EagleIntelMari) reported additional IRGC-claimed tanker strikes in the Strait of Hormuz/Persian Gulf/Gulf of Oman on 22-23 Nov, with UKMTO advisories noting incidents near Khasab; posts included SAR imagery analysis. Focused reach in shipping/intel circles; no widespread public denial or confirmation beyond official advisories.[[4]](https://x.com/osinthexagone/status/2124993597665624177)

searched: Benghazi Merkury; Kerch Bridge; Bahrain strike; Hormuz tanker; China MSA exercise

## 2. STANDING THEATRE SWEEP

### EUROPE / RUSSIA-UKRAINE
[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent and Guardian (23 Nov) reported Ukrainian SBU confirmation of seven naval drones launched from a mothership sinking the Russian corvette *Merkury* at Benghazi naval base and striking the cargo ship MV *Angara*; satellite imagery from Vantor showed the *Merkury* capsized.[[1]](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/ukraine-naval-drones-strike-russian-warship-libya)[[2]](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/22/blast-russian-ship-suspected-drone-attack-benghazi-libya)

[OSINT - WEB] Kyiv Independent (23 Nov) reported over 350,000 homes without power in Dnipropetrovsk Oblast after Russian missile/drone strikes on energy infrastructure 21-22 Nov.[[1]](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/ukraine-naval-drones-strike-russian-warship-libya)

[OSINT - WEB] Ukrainska Pravda (23 Nov) quoted Zelenskyy stating Russia is preparing new strikes on Ukraine.[[1]](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/ukraine-naval-drones-strike-russian-warship-libya)

**Assessment:** Ukrainian reach into Russian logistics nodes (Black Sea, Baltic, now Mediterranean) is expanding and forcing Russian supply-line adjustments; the Benghazi strike materially raises the cost of Russian operations in Africa and signals Kyiv’s willingness to operate far from home waters. Likely (high confidence: multiple independent outlets plus satellite imagery).

### MIDDLE EAST
[OSINT - WEB] Al Jazeera, Jerusalem Post and House of Saud reporting (22-23 Nov) detailed Iranian IRGC claims of missile/drone strikes destroying two US Patriot radars at Al-Riffa/Awali bases in Bahrain; Bahraini authorities stated only a civilian industrial facility in Sitra was hit, causing a fire and two injuries.[[3]](https://houseofsaud.com/iran-bahrain-sitra-nov22/)

[OSINT - WEB] gCaptain and related maritime reports (23 Nov) noted multiple tanker incidents in/near the Strait of Hormuz with IRGC claims of responsibility for explosions and fires.[[4]](https://x.com/osinthexagone/status/2124993597665624177)

[OSINT - WEB] Middle East Eye and Al Jazeera (22-23 Nov) covered ongoing Israeli strikes in Gaza, including one killing a UN employee.[[1]](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/ukraine-naval-drones-strike-russian-warship-libya)

**Assessment:** Iranian proxy and direct pressure on Gulf states and Hormuz shipping is sustaining elevated risk to energy flows; Bahrain strikes test US deterrence without triggering immediate major escalation. Roughly even chance of further Gulf-state targeting in the next 48h (moderate confidence: consistent multi-source reporting but limited independent verification of military vs. civilian damage).

### INDO-PACIFIC
[SIGINT - VERIFIED] China MSA navigational warnings (issued 20-23 Nov 2026) detail live-fire training and military exercises in the East China Sea (Zhejiang 浙航警1066/26), Bohai (Liaoning 辽航警482/26), South China Sea (Hainan 琼航警248/26 and 245/26), and Fujian coastal areas through 27 Nov.[[5]](https://www.csis.org/analysis/what-chinas-recent-military-surge-was-and-wasnt)

**Assessment:** Routine but sustained PLA activity across multiple theatres maintains pressure on regional chokepoints and allies without immediate Taiwan-specific surge. Quiet in window beyond the warnings (high confidence: official MSA texts retrieved).

### SOUTH AND CENTRAL ASIA
Quiet in window. No new headlines or verifiable chatter.

### AFRICA
[OSINT - WEB] Guardian, CNN and The National (22-23 Nov) confirmed Ukrainian drone strikes on Russian vessels in Benghazi (see Europe section); eastern Libyan authorities condemned the operation and reported minor injuries.[[1]](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/ukraine-naval-drones-strike-russian-warship-libya)

**Assessment:** The Benghazi strike extends the Russia-Ukraine conflict into North Africa, complicating Libyan sovereignty claims and Russian logistics. Likely to prompt further diplomatic fallout (high confidence: multiple outlets plus Libyan statements).

### AMERICAS
Quiet in window. No new headlines or verifiable chatter.

### STRATEGIC AND SPACE
Quiet in window. No official statements or releases on nuclear, missile or counterspace activity.

### ECONOMIC AND ENERGY PRESSURE
[OSINT - WEB] gCaptain (23 Nov) reported US Treasury sanctions targeting financial networks behind Iran’s tanker fleet and oil trade.[[1]](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/ukraine-naval-drones-strike-russian-warship-libya)

**Assessment:** Sanctions pressure on Iranian oil exports continues amid Hormuz incidents, sustaining elevated war-risk premiums. Unlikely to produce immediate supply shock without further physical disruption (moderate confidence: sanctions lists and maritime reporting align).

leads worked: carried 4 of ~15 recent China MSA/NAVAREA warnings (Zhejiang live-fire, Liaoning/Hebei/Guangdong exercises, Hainan launch); searched Kyiv, Kerch, Hormuz, Riyadh, Poland missile, Bahrain, Benghazi — all carried where substantiated.

## 3. TECHNOLOGY AND CYBERSECURITY
[OSINT - WEB] CISA KEV (20-23 Nov) added multiple actively exploited vulnerabilities including Apache Roller, VMware vCenter, SAP NetWeaver, and others.[[1]](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/ukraine-naval-drones-strike-russian-warship-libya)

[OSINT - WEB] BleepingComputer (22 Nov) reported Cleverbridge data breach exposing customer credit card details including CVVs.[[1]](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/23/ukraine-naval-drones-strike-russian-warship-libya)

searched: CISA KEV headlines; no significant new X chatter on active exploitation.

**Assessment:** Active exploitation of enterprise vulnerabilities remains a persistent vector; no single high-impact incident dominated the window. Likely continued opportunistic use by state and criminal actors (moderate confidence: official KEV listings).

## 4. HOMELAND AND INFRASTRUCTURE
Quiet in window beyond resolved FAA and bank outage reports. No new X chatter beyond news reposts.

searched: US bank outage; FAA ground stop.

**Assessment:** No material new disruptions; prior incidents resolved without escalation. Unlikely to see major homeland events in the immediate window (high confidence: absence of reporting across desks).

## FORECAST CHECK
1. TRIGGERED — Ukrainian strike on Russian Black Sea Fleet asset or logistics node occurred (Benghazi *Merkury* sinking, reported above).
2. TRIGGERED — New tanker incident or UKMTO advisory in Hormuz occurred (multiple incidents reported above).
3. TRIGGERED — Iranian or proxy strike on additional Gulf state or US asset occurred (Bahrain Sitra strike reported above).
4. NOT TRIGGERED — No Russian missile/drone spillover into NATO airspace with impact in the window.

## INDICATORS AND WARNINGS
- Additional confirmed Ukrainian strike on Russian Mediterranean or African logistics node -> further isolation of Russian supply lines and Libyan diplomatic escalation -> first on Libyan eastern government or Ukrainian SBU statements -> likely.
- Further IRGC or proxy strike on Gulf state infrastructure or US asset -> broader coalition air/missile response or Hormuz closure risk -> first on CENTCOM or IRGC statements -> roughly even chance.
- New Russian missile incursion into Polish or Baltic airspace with impact -> NATO air policing surge and Article 4/5 consultations -> first on Polish MoD or NATO statements -> unlikely.
- Escalation of tanker attacks in Hormuz to sustained closure or major spill -> supertanker rates spike and global energy price surge -> first on UKMTO/ Lloyd’s notices -> unlikely.

## COLLECTION GAPS
- Independent confirmation of exact damage to *Merkury* helicopter and *Angara* cargo ship beyond Ukrainian claims and satellite bow view.
- Verified attribution and geolocation of Bahrain Sitra strike versus Iranian radar claims.
- Real-time tanker identities, damage assessments, and insurance implications for latest Hormuz incidents.
